BiblicalUsage: Chalaq means smooth — smooth skin, and smooth words. Jacob said he was a smooth man beside his hairy brother, the strange woman's mouth is smoother than oil, a flattering mouth works ruin, and God promises there will be no more flattering divination in Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe smooth is the most dangerous word in Proverbs: smooth skin nearly cost Jacob his blessing, and a smooth mouth costs a man his soul. God promises an end to flattery, and that is a promise worth holding.
